questions.html: Which of the following is used in the application layer of TCP/IP model to exchange electronic mail?
questions.solution:
(b)
• Simple Mail Transfer Protocol (SMTP) is a TCP/IP protocol used in sending and receiving
emails over a network such as the internet.
• File Transfer Protocol (FTP) is a standard communication protocol used for the transfer of
computer files from a server to a client on a computer network.
• Remote Procedure Call (RPC) is a protocol that allows a program to request a service from
another program on a different computer in a network.
• Post Office Protocol (POP) is an application-layer protocol used by e-mail clients to retrieve email
from a mail server.

questions.html:
Consider the following statements regarding types of Topology :
1. One of the advantages of Star topology is less cabling cost as the amount of cable required to connect computers is less.
2. Ring Topology is used in high performance networks where large bandwidth is necessary.
Which of the above statements is/are INCORRECT?
questions.solution:
(a)
In Star Topology, all the devices are connected to a single hub through a cable. Thus, Star Topology
requires long cables to connect each node to the server which increases cabling cost.

questions.html:
Consider the following statements about CERT-In:
1. CERT-In is the national nodal agency for responding to computer security incidents as and when they occur.
2. It stands for Cyber Emergency response Team-India.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(a)
CERT-In stands for Indian Computer Emergency Response Team.

questions.html:
Consider the following statements about DigiLocker:
1. DigiLocker provides 100 MB secure dedicated personal electronic space for storing the documents.
2. It allows users to access their e-documents irrespective of their physical location.
3. It is linked to the Aadhar number of the user.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(d)
DigiLocker is a digital service provided by the MeitY under Digital India programme. It enables
Indian citizens to securely store and access their digital documents and certificates. It is linked to
an applicant’s Aadhar number.
The storage space provided was 100 MB initially in DigiLocker, which was later increased to 1 GB.
The individual file size for upload cannot exceed 10 MB. Hence, only statements 2 and 3 are
correct.

questions.html: Which of the following is a form of hacking that lets attackers access a device through its discoverable Bluetooth connection?
questions.solution:
(a)
• Bluebugging is a form of hacking that allows attackers to access a device through its discoverable
Bluetooth connection, essentially taking control of it to make calls, send messages, or access
data.
• Bluesnarfing is a Bluetooth security threat which is used to steal data from a phone.
• Clickjacking refers to any attack where the user is tricked into unintentionally clicking an
unexpected web page element.
• Phishing is an attempt by cybercriminals posing as legitimate institutions, usually via email, to
obtain sensitive information from targeted individuals.

questions.html: Which of the following layers of OSI Model is responsible for the syntax and semantics of the information exchanged between two systems?
questions.solution:
(c)
The presentation layer is concerned with the syntax and semantics of the information exchanged between two systems. The presentation layer formats and translates data depending on the syntax or semantics accepted by the application.

questions.html: What is the standard length of a MAC address?
questions.solution:
(d)
• A MAC address (media access control address) is a 12-digit hexadecimal number assigned to each device connected to the network.
• Historically, MAC addresses are 48 bits long. They have two halves: the first 24 bits form the Organizationally Unique Identifier (OUI) and the last 24 bits form a serial number (formally called an extension identifier).

questions.html:
Consider the following statements:
1. Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions (MIME) is an extension of the original Simple Mail Transport Protocol (SMTP) Email protocol.
3. MIME can reject mail that exceeds a certain size, but there is no word limit in SMTP.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(a)
• MIME (Multipurpose Internet Mail Extensions) is a standard used to extend the format of email messages, allowing them to include more than just text. It enables the transmission of multimedia content such as images, audio, video, and attachments, within email messages, as
well as other types of content types.
• Simple Mail Transport Protocol (SMTP) can reject mail that exceeds a certain size, but there is no word limit in MIME.

questions.html:
Consider the following statements:
1. USSD stands for Unstructured Short Service Data.
2. SMS is a store and forward technology, whereas USSD texts and interactions are not stored on the mobile phone.
3. USSD messages are up to 282 alphanumeric characters long.
Which of the above statements is/are NOT correct?
questions.solution:
(d)
• USSD stands for Unstructured Supplementary Service Data is a communication protocol used in GSM networks for sending short text messages.
• USSD messages are up to 182 alphanumeric characters long.
• SMS works on a store-and-forward basis; i.e. when one device sends an SMS to another, no dedicated communication channel is opened, and there is always a short delay in the recipient getting the message. By contrast, when a device sends out a USSD request, a transparent
channel is automatically established between sender and recipient. In this way, the recipient can respond to the sender’s requests in real time. Thus, USSD texts and interactions are not stored on the mobile phone.

questions.html:
Consider the following statements:
1. SDMA increases the capacity of system and transmission quality by focussing the signal into narrow transmission beams.
2. CDMA assigns a unique code sequence to each user that is used to code data before transmission.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(c)
• Space Division Multiple Access (SDMA) controls the radiated energy for each user in space. It serves different users by using spot beam antennas with same frequency. Thus, SDMA increases the capacity of system and transmission quality by focussing the signal into narrow transmission
beams.
• CDMA uses unique codes to differentiate users sharing the same frequency band at the same time.

questions.html: Which type of cyber-attack occurs when an attacker inserts malicious code into a server that uses SQL and forces the server to reveal information it normally would not?
questions.solution:
(c)
SQL injection (SQLi) is a web security vulnerability that allows an attacker to interfere with the
SQL-based queries that an application makes to its database to access information that was not
intended to be displayed.

questions.html:
Consider the following statements regarding National Agriculture Market (eNAM):
1. It promotes better marketing opportunities for the farmers to sell their produce through online, competitive and transparent price discovery system and online payment facility.
2. It facilitates farmers, traders and buyers with online trading in commodities.
3. e-NAM is entirely funded by the Central Government and is implemented by Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(d)
National Agriculture Market (e-NAM) is a pan-India electronic trading portal which networks the existing Agricultural Produce Market Committee (APMC) mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities. It facilitates farmers, traders and buyers with online trading in
commodities. Launched on April 14, 2016, e-NAM is completely funded by the Central Government and is implemented by Small Farmers Agribusiness  onsortium (SFAC), under the aegis of Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers’ Welfare.

questions.html:
Consider the following statements regarding Active-Matrix Organic Light Emitting Diode (AMOLED):
1. It is a light-emitting and thin-film display technology in which electroluminescent organic compounds are placed on a base layer.
2. AMOLEDs have a higher contrast ratio, a faster response time. and their battery power consumption is significantly less.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
Which of the following memory has the shortest access time?
questions.solution:
(b)
Correct sequence for Memory Access Time is Magnetic Disk > RAM (Primary memory) > Cache >
Memory Registers. Thus, among the given options, Cache memory has the shortest access time. It
is used to hold the frequently used instructions/data which the processor may require next.

questions.html:
Consider the following statements regarding the Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) Technology:
1. It is a technology that allows to make voice calls using a broadband Internet connection instead of a regular phone line.
2. Voice over Internet Protocol is more flexible than the Private Box Exchange system.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(c)
Voice over Internet Protocol, allows for making calls through the Internet. A VoIP system is more
flexible than a traditional PBX because new devices can be added without adding to the physical
infrastructure whereas PBX system requires the physical addition of new telephone wires and the
installation of new wall jacks to support connectivity.

questions.html: Bar present at the bottom of the desktop is known as:
questions.solution:
(c)
A Taskbar is a bar displayed at the bottom of a GUI desktop that is used to launch and monitor running applications.

questions.html: A computer programme that translates one program instruction at a time into machine language is called:
questions.solution:
(d)
A computer program that translates one instruction at a time into machine language is called an
Interpreter. Whereas, a compiler translates the entire program at once into machine code.

questions.html: Routers work on which of the following OSI Layers?
questions.solution:
(a)
Routers operate at the Network Layer (Layer 3) of the OSI model. Its primary function is to route
packets between different networks based on the network (IP) addresses.

questions.html:
Consider the following statements about Assembly Language:
1. It uses alphabetic codes in place of Binary numbers used in machine language.
2. It is the easiest language to write programmes.
3. Assembly Language is not required to be translated in the Machine Language.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(a)
• An assembly language is a type of low-level/middle level programming language that is
intended to communicate directly with a computer’s hardware. It is designed to be more
human-readable than machine code but still closely tied to the hardware. It uses alphabetic
codes in place of binary numbers used in machine language. On the other hand, high-level
programming languages are designed to be more human-readable and closer to natural
language, making it easier for programmers to write code.
• Assembly language must be translated into machine language using an assembler before execution.
Hence, statements 2 and 3 are incorrect.

questions.html: Which of the following is an unwanted and unsolicited form of digital communication that does not pose real privacy and security risk?
questions.solution:
(a)
Spam, refers to any unsolicited and often irrelevant or inappropriate messages sent over the internet,
typically to a large number of users, primarily for advertising, phishing, spreading malware, or
other similar purposes.While annoying and sometimes a vehicle for malicious activities (like
phishing), the unwanted message itself isn't a direct threat unless interacted with.

questions.html:
Consider the following statements:
1. In Programmable Read-Only Memory (PROM), data can be modified multiple times.
2. Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory (EPROM) can be modified by the user only once.
3. Electrically Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory (EEPROM) is programmed and erased electronically and the process can be repeated multiple times.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.solution:
(b)
• In programmable Read-Only Memory (PROM), data can be modified only once after manufacture of the device.
• Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory (EPROM) can be erased and reprogrammed multiple times using ultraviolet light.
• Electrically Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory (EEPROM) is a type of non-volatile memory that can be electrically erased and reprogrammed multiple times.

Hence, only statement 3 is correct.

questions.html: Which of the following services is NOT offered in the Session Layer of OSI Model?
questions.solution:
(b)
• The Session Layer of the OSI model is responsible for establishing, managing, and terminating communication sessions between applications which include Dialog Control, Token Management and Synchronization.
• Flow control mechanism is primarily a function of the Transport Layer of the OSI Model, which ensures that a sender does not overwhelm a receiver with too much data at once.

questions.html:
Each of the next items consists of two statements, one labelled as the ‘Statement (I)’ and the other as ‘Statement (II)’. You are to examine these two statements carefully and select the answers to these items using the codes given below:
Codes:
(a) Both Statement (I) and Statement (II) are individually true and Statement (II) is the correct
explanation of Statement (I).
(b) Both Statement (I) and Statement (II) are individually true but Statement (II) is NOT the
correct explanation of Statement (I).
(c) Statement (I) is true but Statement (II) is false.
(d) Statement (I) is false but Statement (II) is true.

Statement (I): Medium Access Control is a sublayer in the Physical layer which deals with the issue of access control to the shared channel.
Statement (II): The network layer is necessary if two systems are connected to different links with connecting devices between the links to ensure the source-to-destination delivery.
questions.solution:
(d)
• Medium Access Control (MAC) is a sublayer in the Data Link layer which deals with the issue
of access control to the shared channel.
• The network layer ensures that each packet gets from its point of origin to its final destination.
If two systems are connected to the same link, there is usually no need for a network layer.
However, if the two systems are attached to different networks (links) with connecting devices
between the networks (links), there is a need for the network layer to accomplish source to destination delivery.
Hence, Statement (I) is false but Statement (II) is true.
